title: Coffee Praline Crunch Ice Cream Cake
changes_from_base: Coffee ice cream layered in a loaf tin with biscuits, a cocoa fudge sauce and nut praline, topped with whipped cream, instead of chocolate sponge and two ice creams.
summary: Soft coffee ice cream is layered with crunchy biscuits, chocolate fudge sauce and chopped nut praline, then frozen into a loaf and served with extra warm fudge and praline on top.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
graham crackers or digestive biscuits (160 g)
cold double cream, whipped stiff just before serving

steps.title: Fudge
steps.text: Stir the 355 ml double cream, 145 g brown sugar, 30 g butter and ½ tsp fine salt on medium heat until melted, about 2 min, then whisk in the 70 g cocoa powder and cook 1-2 min until thick and glossy.

steps.title: Sieve
steps.text: Sieve the fudge, pressing out any lumps, stir in 1 tsp vanilla and cool for 1 h, about 480 ml.

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Soften the 1400 ml coffee ice cream in the fridge for 30 min, then line the lightly oiled loaf tin with film leaving an 8 cm overhang on the long sides.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread 475 ml ice cream in the tin, cover with 3 of the 10 crackers or biscuits broken to fit, spread over 160 ml fudge and scatter half the 340 g praline, then repeat.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Top with the last of the ice cream and 4 more biscuits, then wrap and freeze for at least 4 h, ideally overnight.

steps.title: Turn
steps.text: Rub the tin with a warm, damp cloth, turn the cake out and peel off the film.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with the whipped 180 ml double cream and extra praline, and serve with the remaining fudge, warmed.

tips: Soften the ice cream just enough to spread easily without melting, so the layers stay neat.
Sieve the fudge sauce well to remove any lumps for a smooth, glossy finish.
Warm the reserved fudge gently before serving so it pours easily over each slice.
storage: Keep well wrapped in the freezer and add the cream and praline just before serving. Contains nuts and caffeine.
